'''Jared Tome''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and [[Imperial Prefect]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At one point, Tome operated a "re-education center" that was responsible for tormenting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizers, and he performed medical experiments in them that were considered extreme even by Imperial standards. He was later appointed as a diplomat and he tried to cover up his sinister past. After the criminal [[Begas Tok]] stole the [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] program the [[Shard of Alderaan]] from the Alliance, Tome attended an auction aboard the ''[[Dune Princess]]'' [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at which the program was to be sold.<ref name="The Shard of Alderaan" />
